messages.content: Write one concise customer-service reply using only the supplied policy facts. State an action only when action_committed is true.

Customer request: My $350 blender arrived broken. Refund it please.
Facts: {'order_id': 'ORD-0004', 'requested_resolution': 'cash refund', 'allowed': False, 'amount': None, 'reason': 'Cash refunds above $200 are not automatically approved.', 'alternative': 'Offer store credit.', 'action_committed': False}

response.text: Hi, I'm sorry your blender arrived broken. For order ORD-0004, I can't automatically approve a cash refund on purchases over $200, so I'm not able to process one right now. What I can offer is store credit. Would you like to go that route?
